text: {"lessons":["My account is up overall despite a few monthly declines, but this short, noisy record does not show that recent price moves predict what comes next.","Making no trades so far avoided unnecessary reactions; I should still review whether my holdings and cash fit my risk and diversification goals rather than treating inaction as automatically best.","I should not let reluctance to admit a loss or the pleasure of locking in a gain override a consistent, forward-looking investment plan."]}
